name: wcagcheck
description: Accessibility checker mapping WCAG 2.2 findings to EN 301 549 clauses

scripts.sync:axe: mkdir -p public/vendor && cp node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js public/vendor/axe-$(node -p "require('axe-core/package.json').version").min.js && cp node_modules/axe-core/LICENSE public/vendor/LICENSE-axe-core.txt && echo 'Now update AXE_URL and AXE_VERSION in public/axe-runner.js, and delete the old vendored file.'
